ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In the figure, in the Cartesian coordinate plane, point $A(2, m)$ and point $B(6, 2)$ lie on the graph of an inverse proportionality function. What is the equation of the line $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let the inverse proportion function be $y=\frac{k}{x}$,\\
$\because$ point $A(2, m)$ and point $B(6, 2)$ lie on the graph of $y=\frac{k}{x}$,\\
$\therefore k=2m=6\times 2$,\\
Solving this gives $m=6$,\\
$\therefore$ the coordinates of point $A$ are $(2, 6)$,\\
Let the expression for line $AB$ be $y=ax+b$,\\
Substituting $A(2, 6)$ and $B(6, 2)$ into it gives $\left\{\begin{array}{l}2a+b=6 \\ 6a+b=2\end{array}\right.$,\\
Solving this yields $\left\{\begin{array}{l}a=-1 \\ b=8\end{array}\right.$,\\
$\therefore$ the expression for line $AB$ is $y=-x+8$, hence the expression for line $AB$ is $\boxed{y=-x+8}$.
